aiResearchSummary.text: Millibatt, Inc is engaged in developing battery separator technologies, as described in the system and method for depositing separator material, which details dispensing separator material droplets onto a substrate tape. The company is also researching three-dimensional folded battery units and methods for manufacturing them, as well as methods for forming 3D batteries with horizontally-interdigitated electrodes. These activities focus on separator material deposition and advanced battery architectures.
